market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CL at ~$103, recent peak $109. To hit a $120 settlement by end of June (2 months) requires a ~17% rise from spot. Hormuz disruption ongoing and Iran-US deadlocked, but markets have been oscillating. Plausible scenario, but well above recent settlements. Probability ~38-46%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Direction of Hormuz negotiations and possible escalation/de-escalation through May/June.
